info.name: Swagger Petstore
info.description: Create, read, update and delete a pet, with the response checked against the published Swagger definition. The collection owns the pet it creates and deletes it at the end.

exec: // Postman's validator (tv4) does not know Swagger's int32/int64 formats, so 'format' keywords are dropped before use.

const stripFormat = (node) => { if (Array.isArray(node)) node.forEach(stripFormat); else if (node && typeof node === 'object') { delete node.format; Object.values(node).forEach(stripFormat); } return node; };

pm.test('Swagger 2.0 document with a Pet definition', () => { const s = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(s.swagger).to.eql('2.0'); pm.expect(s.definitions).to.have.property('Pet'); pm.collectionVariables.set('petSchema', JSON.stringify(stripFormat({ ...s.definitions.Pet, definitions: s.definitions }))); });

pm.test('echoes id and status', () => { const p = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(p.id).to.eql(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('petId'))); pm.expect(p.status).to.eql('available'); pm.collectionVariables.set('petName', p.name); });

item.name: TC-PS-005 Find by status sold includes the pet

exec: pm.test('every pet is sold', () => pm.expect(pets.filter(p => p.status !== 'sold')).to.be.empty);
pm.test('the updated pet is listed', () => pm.expect(pets.some(p => p.id === Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('petId')))).to.be.true);

item.name: TC-PS-002 Deleted pet is not found

exec: pm.test('404 with an error body', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(404); pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql('Pet not found'); });

item.name: TC-PS-006 Invalid status gives an empty list

exec: pm.test('object of integer counts', () => { const inv = pm.response.json(); Object.values(inv).forEach(v => pm.expect(Number.isInteger(v)).to.be.true); });
